d: German Standard Group (GSG) is seeking a dedicated and organized Academy Assistant (Veterinary Nurse) to join GSG Academy in Qatar.
The ideal candidate must have a veterinary nursing background, with the ability to support practical veterinary training sessions, workshops, and academy operations.
q: Mandatory: Qualification in Veterinary Nursing, Veterinary Technology, or a closely related veterinary field.
Previous practical experience working as a Veterinary Nurse or Veterinary Technician.
Good knowledge of veterinary instruments, clinical procedures, and animal handling.
Experience assisting in veterinary surgeries or clinical procedures is highly preferred.
Ability to support both practical training activities and administrative tasks.
Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.
Experience in veterinary training centers or educational institutions is an advantage.
r: li
Assist veterinarians and trainers during practical training sessions, workshops, and educational programs.
li
Prepare and organize veterinary instruments, medical equipment, and training materials.
li
Support animal handling, restraint, and nursing procedures during practical sessions.
li
Ensure proper cleaning, sterilization, and maintenance of veterinary instruments and equipment.
li
Assist with the preparation and setup of training facilities.
li
Coordinate training schedules, participant registrations, and attendance records.
li
Maintain appropriate hygiene, infection control, and animal welfare standards.
li
Provide administrative and operational support for academy activities.
li
Coordinate with trainers and participants to ensure smooth execution of training programs.

d: SANY has been present in Middle- East market since 2004 and has built a strong regional presence supporting customers across multiple countries and regions. Our Oman operations provide equipment, service, and spare parts solutions, supported by an extensive service and parts network.
At SANY, we are committed to supporting our customers through reliable equipment, strong partnerships, and comprehensive service solutions.
q: We are looking for a driven and customer-focused Spare Parts Sales Specialist to join our team in Oman.
This is a field-based sales role for someone who enjoys meeting customers, building relationships, identifying business opportunities, and driving sales growth.
If you have experience selling spare parts or working within the heavy equipment, machinery, or related industry, we'd love to hear from you.
Minimum 3 years of sales experience in spare parts, heavy equipment, machinery, or a related industry.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Experience in field sales and managing customer relationships.
A valid Oman Driving License – mandatory .
Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a field-based role.
r: li
Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
li
Conduct regular field and customer visits across the Oman.
li
Identify new business opportunities and drive spare parts sales.
li
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable spare parts solutions.
li
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
li
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth order processing and customer support.
li
Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
x: Opportunity to work with a growing and dynamic team.
Exposure to the heavy equipment and machinery industry.
A role where you can directly contribute to business growth and build strong industry relationships.
